message.content:
Here is an extreme detailed breakdown of the **Throwback Jersey** e-commerce website design, structured for precise recreation:

---

## 1. BRAND IDENTITY & LOGO
- **Logo**: "Throwback Jersey" in a custom **handwritten script font** (resembling *Pacifico* or *Brush Script*), colored in **metallic gold/yellow (#D4AF37)** with a slight texture/grunge effect
- **Tagline**: "WEAR THE LEGACY" in small caps sans-serif (tracking: 0.2em) to the right of the logo, separated by a thin vertical gold line
- **Favicon/Icon**: Small shopping bag with "0" badge (cart indicator)

---

## 2. HEADER & NAVIGATION
**Structure**: Fixed/sticky header with transparent background (overlays hero image)
- **Left**: Logo + Tagline
- **Center Navigation** (all caps, letter-spacing: 0.15em, font-size: 11px, color: white):
  - HOME (underlined/gold active state)
  - OUR STORY
  - COLLECTIONS
  - LEGENDS
  - IMPACT
  - JOURNAL
  - CONTACT
- **Right Icons**:
  - Search icon (magnifying glass outline)
  - Cart icon (shopping bag) with yellow circular badge containing "0"

---

## 3. HERO SECTION (Full Viewport Height)
**Background Image**: 
- Dramatic photograph of Zimbabwean football fan from behind, right arm raised in fist, wearing jersey with **Zimbabwe flag colors** (green, yellow, red, black horizontal stripes)
- Holding large Zimbabwe flag waving in wind (green-yellow-red-black stripes with white triangle containing red star and yellow bird)
- **Lighting**: Golden hour/sunset backlighting creating lens flare and silhouette effect
- **Atmosphere**: Stadium crowd visible in background, dusty/hazy warm tones

**Overlay Content (Left-Aligned)**:
- **Eyebrow text**: "ZIMBABWEAN SPORTING FANATICS" (white, 11px, tracking: 0.3em, uppercase)
- **Main Headline**: 
  - "MORE THAN A" (White, bold sans-serif, ~72px, condensed)
  - "JERSEY" (**Gold gradient/text fill**, same size, heavy weight)
  - "It's Our Story." (Script font, white, elegant, slightly italicized, underlining the word "Our")
- **Body Copy** (white, 16px, line-height: 1.6, max-width: 480px):
  > "From the dusty pitches to the nation's biggest stages, Zimbabwean football has always been about more than a game. It's about resilience. It's about unity. It's about a nation that never stops believing.
  >
  > Throwback Jersey brings those unforgettable moments back to life — so you can wear the legacy."
  
- **CTA Buttons**:
  1. **Primary**: "EXPLORE THE COLLECTION →" (Gold border 2px, gold text, transparent background, padding: 16px 32px, uppercase, arrow icon)
  2. **Secondary**: "▶ WATCH OUR STORY" (White text with play circle icon, no border, ghost button style)

**Right Side Vertical Text** (rotated 90° or stacked):
- "Wear" (script, white)
- "the Legacy" (script, white, larger)
- Below that, vertical stack of words (right-aligned, white, 10px, tracking: 0.3em):
  - PEOPLE
  - PASSION
  - HERITAGE
  - ZIMBABWE
  - FOREVER

---

## 4. IMAGE BANNER STRIP ("THE PAST LIVES ON")
**Layout**: Full-width horizontal collage of 4 images with dark overlay
- **Center Text Overlay**: "THE PAST LIVES ON" (White, bold, 36px, letter-spacing: 0.4em, centered across all images)

**Image 1 (Left)**: Black & white photo of three football players in striped jerseys (black/white vertical stripes), celebrating with arms around each other, stadium crowd blurred behind

**Image 2 (Center-Left)**: Sepia/B&W image of ancient stone ruins (Great Zimbabwe style walls) with trees

**Image 3 (Center-Right)**: **Product shot** - Close-up of grey/heather jersey fabric showing:
- Zimbabwe flag colors on collar/shoulder (green, yellow, red stripes)
- Central emblem: Red star with yellow Zimbabwe Bird (Hungwe) silhouette inside a basket/shield shape
- Fabric texture visible (cotton/polyester blend)

**Image 4 (Right)**: Black & white crowd photo with hand-held sign reading: "ZIMBABWE ALWAYS A NATION OF WINNERS"

---

## 5. "OUR STORY" SECTION (Split Layout)
**Background**: Light textured off-white/beige (#F5F5F0) with subtle paper grain or concrete texture

**Left Column (Text)**:
- **Label**: "OUR STORY" (gold, 11px, tracking: 0.3em, uppercase)
- **Headline**: "ROOTED IN A NATION BUILT ON PASSION" (Black, bold, 48px, condensed sans-serif, line-height: 1.1)
- **Body Text** (dark grey #333, 16px, line-height: 1.7):
  > "Throwback Jersey was born from a simple belief — that Zimbabwe's sporting heritage deserves to be remembered, celebrated and worn with pride.
  >
  > We honour the legends, the teams, the moments, and the fans who kept the dream alive. Every jersey tells a story. Every story keeps the legacy going."
- **Button**: "OUR STORY →" (Black background, white text, gold arrow, padding: 14px 28px)

**Right Column (Image)**:
- **Photograph**: Young Black boy looking upward with hopeful expression (skyward gaze)
- **Face paint**: Zimbabwean flag colors painted diagonally across his cheek (green, yellow, red, black stripes)
- **Background**: Blurred stadium setting with "ZIMBABWE GO FURTHER" signage partially visible
- **Overlay Quote** (script font, gold/dark brown, rotated slightly): *"Different Generations. Same Passion."* (with underline swoosh)

---

## 6. FEATURES/VALUES BAR (Dark Section)
**Background**: Near black (#0A0A0A) or very dark charcoal
**Layout**: 4 columns with icons + text

| Icon | Title | Subtitle |
|------|-------|----------|
| 🏆 Trophy cup (gold outline) | ICONIC MOMENTS | Never Forgotten |
| 👥 Three people silhouettes (gold outline) | LEGENDARY PLAYERS | Always Inspiring |
| 🚩 Flag (gold outline) | PROUD NATION | Forever United |
| ❤️ Heart (gold outline) | BRIGHTER FUTURES | Powered by Football |

**Typography**: Titles in white (12px, uppercase, tracking: 0.2em), Subtitles in grey (#888, 13px)

**Bottom Right Accent**: Large brush-stroke texture element (gold/yellow paint smear) with "Wear the Legacy" in script font overlapping it

---

## 7. COLOR PALETTE SPECIFICATIONS
```
Primary Gold:     #D4AF37 (Metallic Gold - used for logo, "JERSEY" text, accents)
Secondary Gold:   #C9A227 (Darker gold for hovers)
Pure White:       #FFFFFF (Headlines, body text on dark backgrounds)
Off-White:        #FAF9F6 (Section backgrounds)
Charcoal Black:   #1A1A1A (Dark sections)
Deep Black:       #0D0D0D (Footer/Features bar)
Text Grey:        #666666 (Body copy on light backgrounds)
Zimbabwe Green:   #319E49 (Flag reference)
Zimbabwe Yellow:  #FFD100 (Flag reference)
Zimbabwe Red:     #BF211E (Flag reference)
```

---

## 8. TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM
- **Headlines**: **Bebas Neue**, **Oswald**, or **Anton** (Condensed, bold, all caps for display text)
- **Subheadlines/Nav**: **Montserrat** or **Roboto Condensed** (Medium weight, wide tracking)
- **Body Copy**: **Open Sans**, **Lato**, or **Source Sans Pro** (Regular, 16px, line-height 1.6)
- **Script/Accent**: **Pacifico**, **Great Vibes**, or **Brush Script MT** (For "It's Our Story", "Wear the Legacy", quotes)
- **UI Elements**: System-ui or Inter (for buttons, labels)

---

## 9. PRODUCT DETAILS (Visible Items)
Only one product is clearly shown in detail:
- **Item**: Zimbabwe National Team Retro/Throwback Jersey
- **Colorway**: Heather Grey body with Zimbabwe flag trim on collar/shoulders
- **Badge**: Central chest emblem featuring:
  - Red 5-pointed star
  - Yellow Zimbabwe Bird (Hungwe) perched on basket/woven ring
  - Representing the national coat of arms elements
- **Fabric**: Appears to be cotton-polyester blend with slight heather texture
- **Price**: Not visible in this landing page view (likely revealed on click/collection page)

---

## 10. UI ELEMENTS & MICRO-INTERACTIONS
- **Buttons**: 
  - Primary: Transparent with 2px solid gold border, gold text, hover fills with gold, text turns black
  - Secondary: Solid black background, white text, hover darkens
  - Ghost: No border, just icon + text, underline on hover
- **Search**: Expands from icon to input field on click
- **Cart**: Fixed position, shows item count in circular badge
- **Image Treatment**: All photos have slight desaturation (except hero which is warm/golden), possible subtle grain overlay
- **Dividers**: Thin gold lines (1px) used as section separators

---

## 11. FOOTER CONTENT (Implied/Partial)
While not fully visible, standard elements for this type of site would include:
- Newsletter signup ("Join the Legacy")
- Social media icons (Instagram, Twitter/X, Facebook)
- Payment method icons
- Copyright "© 2024 Throwback Jersey. All Rights Reserved."
- Links: Privacy Policy, Terms, Shipping, Returns
- "Wear the Legacy" script logo repetition

---

## RECREATION TECHNICAL NOTES
- **Framework**: Likely React/Next.js or vanilla HTML with Tailwind CSS
- **Image Handling**: Background images use `background-size: cover` with `overlay: linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.4), rgba(0,0,0,0.6))`
- **Fonts**: Google Fonts combination: Bebas Neue (headings) + Open Sans (body) + Pacifico (script)
- **Responsive**: Stacks vertically on mobile (hero text centers, feature bar becomes 2x2 grid)
- **Animations**: Subtle fade-in on scroll, parallax on hero image, hover scale on product images

This design emphasizes **heritage, passion, and national pride** through its use of warm gold tones against dark, dramatic photography, with the Zimbabwean flag serving as the primary visual motif throughout.
